info.name: Auth & User Management API v1.0
info.description:
Fit for Surgery - Auth & User Management module. Implements Auth API reference v1.0.

Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner. Select the "Auth API - Local" environment first.
Each run registers one test doctor, one test admin and one test patient (emails at ffs-health.test, which nobody receives) and deactivates the doctor and patient at the end.

exec: pm.test('role PATIENT, email verified', () => { pm.expect(me.role).to.eql('PATIENT'); pm.expect(me.emailVerified).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('has time zone and doctors', () => { pm.expect(p.timeZone).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(p.doctors).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });
const arjun = docs.find(d => d.name === 'Dr Arjun Rao');
pm.test('Dr Arjun Rao exists (npm run seed:dev-users)', () => pm.expect(arjun).to.be.an('object'));
pm.test('linked to the registering doctor', () => pm.expect(p.doctors.map(d => d.id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('doctorId')));
pm.test('new patient is under Dr Arjun', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(p => p.id)).to.include(pm.environment.get('newPatientId')));
